propositions: A file touched by two or more bug-fix commits on the base branch within 7 days signals a repeat-fix escalation independent of diff size, catching 12 of 22 regression-labeled commits (50% recall) at 35.2% corpus escalation vs 16.3% for the size floor alone.

The repeat-fix predicate must run on diffs below the 150-line threshold to catch under-floor regressions; the gate evaluates size floor OR repeat-fix condition in order (non-test paths empty returns early, then both checks, then attestation classification unchanged).

Under-floor repeat-fix verdicts emit a new `escalation_reason` field in coverage (size/repeat-fix/size+repeat-fix) and `repeat_fix_priors` list, while the `flagged` field remains pinned to size floor alone to preserve --check-planning-corpus invariants.

The repeat-fix predicate walks git log --no-merges per non-test path on the base branch, counting commits whose message resolves to a bug ticket via the existing ticket_for_commit_message resolver, yielding no exception on git failures.

Backtest gains --repeat-fix and --labels-from-caused-by flags to measure recall against the store's caused_by field (derived via rebar.metrics.blame.derive_caused_by), recomputing corpus figures rather than freezing plan-era snapshots.

The review-plan mirror in orchestrator.bug_blast_radius_escalates is a no-op (already escalates any non-test file impact) and remains unimplemented; orchestrator.py and workflow_ops.py are reviewed but not changed.
